none: PAS LVPL-98F755: Roman Samian ware bowl
contea di ritrovamento: Leicestershire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Base of a Samian Ware cup, Form 27 or 33. Just over half of the base remains, with nothing of the sides of the vessel left. The interior of the base is slightly domed. The underside of the base has 2 grooved lines around its circumference. The footring is at a 45degree angle and although the sides are missing, they would have curved up quite sharply.
